raw_response:
Most likely diagnosis: Diabetic ketoacidosis.

The findings supporting this are: known type 1 diabetes with missed insulin, hyperglycaemia, metabolic acidosis with high anion gap.

Other possibilities to consider include hyperosmolar hyperglycaemic state, acute gastroenteritis, acute pancreatitis.

Recommendation: confirm the diagnosis with the appropriate investigations, start guideline-based management and arrange senior review.
